title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Siddhu The Warrior
desc: A rich man does everything he can to restore his mother's failing health. However, finding no success, he follows the advice of a sage who tells him to turn into a beggar for 48 hours.

title: Odela Railway Station
desc: IPS Officer, Anudeep takes charge as he investigates a series of murders and a whole other conspiracy linked with ritual killing.

title: International Rowdy
desc: Love invents a lethal drug and gives it to terrorist outfits, who use it to kill Indian officials in Kuala Lumpur. When RAW officers find a love emblem tattoo on his neck, they start investigating.

title: Bhaje Vaayu Vegam
desc: A budding cricketer bets big to fund his father's surgery but is betrayed by a bookie. Seeking revenge, he lands on a crime website, facing unexpected dangers that test his resolve.

title: Bhairathi Ranagal
desc: Bhairathi Ranagal ends up in jail after going against the law. However, when he is released, he strives to fight for the people of his village.
